  PROBLEM: Taking the base version of a conflicted live hook before paired live/template processing can leave the live hook and its template unresolved as a pair.
  WHY: The resolver no longer sees both paths as unmerged, so it may resolve the template without mirroring it to the live hook, leaving the copies divergent and violating the parity check.

  PROBLEM: The re-issue deduplication check accepts the marker from any PR commenter without validating the comment author.
  WHY: A commenter can post the marker to suppress future re-issue attempts, leaving the host-only conflict on the manual-merge path.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:543-582 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An empty linked-issue list is treated like an issue with no `files_touched` allowlist, so every host-only conflict path is classified as `take_base`.
  WHY: With no linked issue, the PR scope is unknown; taking the base version can silently discard the hook change instead of leaving the conflict fail-closed.

  WHY: The closed PR can be left without a link to the replacement issue or the deduplication marker; transient failures can also permit a later run to create another replacement issue. Severity disagreement: the highest reported severity is MAJOR; one reviewer also reported NIT.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The implementation takes base for out-of-scope host-only paths only when there are no in-scope paths, rather than applying the documented per-path behavior to mixed-scope conflicts.
  WHY: In a mixed-scope PR, the out-of-scope path remains unresolved and the whole PR is re-issued. Severity disagreement: the highest reported severity is MAJOR; one reviewer also reported NIT.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh: stage-shape whitelist `' 1 2 3 '|' 2 3 '|' 1 2 '|' 1 3 '` (~line 645) vs the resolution branches (`git rm` for `1 2`, else `git checkout MERGE_HEAD -- "${_ho_path}"`) | severity=high | confidence=[3]

  WHY: For a path absent from `MERGE_HEAD`, checkout fails after pre-flight and the prepare step exits with a generic error instead of taking the documented fail-closed path.

- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh
  Line or code reference: The host-only take-base block. It runs check-paths on the raw unmerged set ("python3 \"${_ho_workspace_py}\" check-paths \"$(pwd)\" \"${_ho_dir}/unmerged.txt\" ..."), then on the take_base path runs "git checkout MERGE_HEAD -- \"${_ho_path}\"". Interacting code: scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py lines 541-542 ("if name in PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES: return \"live_safety_hook\""), which reports the live hook as host_only, and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh lines 2334-2353, the paired-live-copies pairing from issue #6595.
  PROBLEM: Preparation takes the base version of the live hook before the resolver forms its live/template pairs.
  WHY: The live path is no longer unmerged, so the later pairing cannot form; resolving the template separately can leave the live hook and its template different and fail the parity check.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh
  Line or code reference: Scope lookup. The Python body splitter iterates "for index, issue in enumerate(issues)", and an empty list writes no body files. The "for _ho_body_file in ...bodies/*.txt" loop then contributes nothing, in_scope.txt stays empty, and every path is printed as "take_base". The empty list with status ok comes from scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh: "_linked_raw_status=ok" when _linked_fetch_ok=true and the PR has no closing references and no body references.
  PROBLEM: A PR with no linked issue is treated like an issue with no `files_touched` allowlist, even though its scope is unknown.
  WHY: On a conflict, the hook change can be silently replaced by the base version and the PR can proceed to auto-merge.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh
  Line or code reference: _resolver_reissue_for_host_only_scope: "if ! gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments\" -F \"body=@${reissue_dir}/pr_comment.md\" ...; then echo \"::warning::... closing anyway ...\"", followed by _resolver_run_unblock_ops on ops_suffix.json, which contains the close
  PROBLEM: The explanation comment is posted by a single unretried `gh api` call, but the PR is still closed when it fails.
  WHY: A transient failure can close the PR without a comment identifying the replacement issue; if closing also fails, a later dispatch can create another replacement because the marker is missing.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
